testConditions.description: User initiates a new planning session
User builds business model through conversation
System generates and presents solution hypothesis
User consults specialist agents
User resumes an interrupted planning session
Administrator manages business pattern library
User exports session plan as structured document
User authenticates and accesses the planner
User views session history and audit log
LLM request rate limit boundary at 50 requests per tenant per hour
Business model confidence score threshold at 70 for hypothesis generation
Pattern match composite confidence threshold at 60
Session list pageSize boundary values 1 and 100
SolutionHypothesis status valid and invalid transitions
PlanningSession status lifecycle transitions
BusinessConcept.conceptType valid and invalid enum partitions
DomainEvent.eventType valid and invalid enum partitions
Role combinations (planner-user, planner-admin, tenant-admin, no-role) against protected resources
Cross-tenant and cross-user session access control decisions
Security attack vectors including XSS payloads and TLS enforcement
Integration stub behavior under nominal and failure conditions
Audit trail completeness and HMAC chain integrity
Unique index violations on MongoDB collection primary keys (sessionId, messageId, etc.)
Required field validation at MongoDB $jsonSchema validator layer (tenantId, hmac)
Enum validator rejections for conceptType, status, role fields
HMAC chain integrity across consecutive audit events
Multi-tenant isolation at MongoDB query layer (tenantId filter enforcement)
Compound unique constraint on user_context user+tenant pair

testCases.title: Create new planning session as planner-user
testCases.objective: Verify a planner-user can create a new PlanningSession via POST /api/v1/sessions and receive the session record with status active.
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user holds planner-user role and no existing session with the same title exists.

testSteps.action: POST /api/v1/sessions with body containing title and tenantId from JWT
testSteps.expected: HTTP 201 Created with PlanningSession body including sessionId, status: active

testSteps.action: GET /api/v1/sessions/:id using the returned sessionId
testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with matching session record confirming persistence

testCases.expectedResults: A new PlanningSession record is persisted in MongoDB with status active and the response body matches the PlanningSession schema.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when HTTP 201 returned with valid sessionId and GET confirms persistence; FAIL on any other HTTP status.

testCases.title: Re-open existing paused session from session list
testCases.objective: Verify a user can navigate to a paused session from the session list and resume it, restoring prior conversation state.
testCases.preconditions: User has an existing session in status paused with at least one ConversationMessage stored.

testSteps.action: GET /api/v1/sessions to retrieve session list
testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with sessions[] containing the paused session

testSteps.action: GET /api/v1/sessions/:id to open the paused session
testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with session status active and conversation history included

testCases.expectedResults: Session status transitions from paused to active and prior conversation messages are accessible.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when session opens with restored context; FAIL if context is lost or status remains paused.

testCases.title: Planning Agent extracts business concepts from natural language input
testCases.objective: Verify the Planning Agent processes a user's natural language problem description and returns a set of typed BusinessConcept entities in the updated BusinessModel.
testCases.preconditions: An active PlanningSession exists and INT-001 LLM stub is configured to return canned concept extraction response.

testSteps.action: POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/messages with user message describing a business problem
testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with assistant message and updated businessModelId reference

testSteps.action: GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/model to retrieve the BusinessModel
testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with concepts[] array containing at least one Actor and one Goal typed concept

testCases.expectedResults: BusinessModel is updated with structured concepts extracted from user input; confidenceScore is calculated.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when concepts[] is non-empty and includes valid conceptType values; FAIL on empty concepts or schema validation error.

testCases.title: Planning Agent returns graceful error when LLM is unavailable
testCases.objective: Verify the system returns a user-friendly error message and HTTP 503 when the LLM API (INT-001) stub is configured to fail-closed.
testCases.preconditions: Active PlanningSession exists and INT-001 stub is set to fail-closed mode.

testSteps.action: POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/messages with user problem description
testSteps.expected: HTTP 503 with ErrorResponse body indicating LLM service unavailable

testSteps.action: Verify session status remains active (not corrupted)
testSteps.expected: GET /api/v1/sessions/:id returns status active with no partial data

testCases.expectedResults: HTTP 503 returned with standard ErrorResponse; session state is preserved intact.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when HTTP 503 and valid ErrorResponse returned without corrupting session; FAIL on 500 or session data loss.

testCases.title: User corrects a BusinessConcept type in the business model

testSteps.action: PATCH /api/v1/sessions/:id/model/concepts/:conceptId with updated conceptType: Actor
testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with updated concept in response body

testSteps.action: GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/model and verify concept type update persisted
testSteps.expected: Concept in model shows conceptType: Actor

testCases.expectedResults: BusinessConcept type is updated to Actor and model version is incremented.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when concept type persists correctly; FAIL on 400 or no change persisted.

testCases.title: User accepts a proposed SolutionHypothesis
testCases.objective: Verify a user can accept a proposed SolutionHypothesis via the API, transitioning its status from proposed to accepted.

testSteps.expected: HTTP 200 with hypothesis status: accepted in response

testSteps.expected: Status is accepted; no other fields altered

testCases.expectedResults: Hypothesis status transitions to accepted and is persisted; domain event hypothesis-generated status update is published.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when status accepted and persisted; FAIL if status unchanged or HTTP error.

testCases.title: Planning Agent delegates to Form Service specialist
testCases.objective: Verify the Planning Agent invokes the Form Service Specialist Agent when form design is identified in the solution hypothesis and returns guidance to the user.
testCases.preconditions: Session has an accepted hypothesis referencing form-service; INT-003 stub is active with isEnabled: true.

testSteps.action: POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/messages requesting form design guidance

testSteps.expected: Response content references form-service specialist output

testCases.expectedResults: Planning Agent delegates to form-service specialist and returns its stub guidance to the user.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when specialist delegation occurs and guidance returned; FAIL if delegation skipped or stub not called.

testCases.title: Resume interrupted planning session restores context
testCases.objective: Verify a user can resume a paused session and the full prior conversation context including the BusinessModel and ConversationMessages is restored.

testCases.expectedResults: All prior session context is available; lastResumedAt is updated; session status transitions to active.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when context fully restored and agent responds coherently; FAIL on missing context or error.

testCases.title: Export session plan returns structured JSON document
testCases.objective: Verify GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/export returns a structured session plan document containing the business model, accepted hypothesis, and session metadata.

testCases.objective: Verify a user with a valid Keycloak JWT carrying the planner-user role can access the planner service and receive a 200 response.

testCases.title: Concurrent session modification conflict detected
testCases.objective: Verify the system detects a concurrent modification conflict when two clients attempt to update the same BusinessModel simultaneously.
testCases.preconditions: Two authenticated sessions hold the same active PlanningSession open.

testSteps.action: Client A and Client B both read the BusinessModel at version 3
testSteps.expected: Both clients receive identical BusinessModel at version 3

testSteps.action: Client A submits update with version 3; Client B submits conflicting update with version 3
testSteps.expected: Client A receives HTTP 200; Client B receives HTTP 409 Conflict

testCases.expectedResults: Only the first write succeeds; the second is rejected with HTTP 409; no data corruption occurs.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when 409 returned for the conflicting update; FAIL if both updates succeed with no conflict detection.

testCases.title: View own session history as planner-user

testCases.expectedResults: Only the authenticated user's sessions are returned; cross-user data is filtered by userId from JWT.
testCases.passFailCriteria: PASS when only own sessions returned and total is accurate; FAIL if other users' sessions appear.

testCases.title: Confidence score 69 does not trigger hypothesis generation
testCases.objective: Verify the Planning Agent does not automatically generate a SolutionHypothesis when BusinessModel.confidenceScore is 69, which is one below the required threshold of 70.
